New Update: Co-op, Cars, New Paid Tools, Second Workpad!
Soon: Fix and resell!

🚧 IN BETA! Expect bugs and changes while we improve the game.

Welcome to UNFIX IT! 🔩
Take things apart, find hidden treasures, and get paid for making a mess!

🪛 Take on jobs and remove screws to dismantle furniture.
💎 Discover rare valuables hidden inside ordinary objects.
💰 Sell your salvage and turn spare parts into cash.
⚡ Upgrade your drill and get powerful tools for bigger jobs.
🤝 Team up with friends and unfix things together! (SOON)

That old chair could be hiding your next big payday. 👀
